35. Article 109 of the Constitution is hereby amended as

(a)
by the substitution for the words “Article 41A” of

President of the Republic” in paragraph 2 thereof.

37.
Article    111D    of    the    Constitution    is    hereby
amended,  by  the substitution for the words “Article 41A” of
the words “Article 41C” in paragraph (1) thereof.

38.

as follows:

(a)
by the substitution for the words “Article 41A” of
the words “Article 41C” in paragraph (5) thereof;

(b)
by  the  addition  of  the  words  “with  the  approval
of    the  Constitutional    Council,”    immediately
after  the  words  “The President may,” in paragraph
(6) thereof.

39.
Article 129 of the Constitution is hereby amended
